metadata.description: Team engineering workflow: issue/PR/review commands and shared rules. Install once, `claude plugin update` to get changes.

plugins.name: pm-kit
plugins.description: Commands: /file-issue, /write-pr, /review-pr, /post-merge, /close-pr, /weekly-status, /board-audit — each enforces the team playbook (evidence over assertion, Closes vs Refs, tiered review, reproduce-then-fix, verify what closed, status from evidence, backlog audited in buckets). Bundles a headless Playwright MCP server: /write-pr and /review-pr click through changed UI on desktop and phone viewports and attach screenshots as evidence.
